S-CORE.Purpose: Provide complete deterministic FLI behavior for normal agent work without model or runtime-framework coupling.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: Runtime: declaration parser, Resolution, graph boundary inference, Discovery, Graph, Context, Delivery.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Knowledge schema contracts: tier matrix, statement grammar, FQID addressing validation.
Scope.SCP-IN-003: Package target: packages/core; canonical CLI `fli` and public TypeScript API `Frostline`.
Scope.SCP-OUT-002: Harness APIs, prompt interpretation, repository-scale semantic inference.

Principles.PRIN-001: Core is the single authority for FLI declaration parsing, graph semantics, and node schema validation.
Principles.PRIN-002: Integrations provide observed file paths and consume Core output; they never infer FLI roots or parse declarations.
Principles.PRIN-003: Core correctness is independent of Agent Skills existence, build, installation, configuration.
Principles.PRIN-004: Dependency direction: Core does not depend on Integrations.
Principles.PRIN-005: Derived cache is disposable acceleration, never semantic authority.

Requirements.REQ-001: Core build, test, use, and release cannot require Agent Skills, a model framework, or provider credentials.
Requirements.REQ-002: Core execution uses deterministic filesystem/state inputs only.
Requirements.REQ-003: Canonical CLI: `fli ancestors FILE [FILE...]` and `fli graph FILE|DIR [--root DIR]`; no `fli read` alias.
Requirements.REQ-004: Public TypeScript API: `Frostline.ancestors`, `Frostline.graph`, `Frostline.resetContext`, `Frostline.resetSession`; no deprecated read request types.
Requirements.REQ-005: Correctness never depends on cache, daemon, watcher, Git state, or long-lived process state; cache removal yields clean rebuild/reinjection only.
